claims.claim: MWN was designed for works licensing in territories without central licensing infrastructure such as the US and Canada, and MWN v1.3 added features for registering works with CMOs.
The CWR specification is not publicly downloadable; CISAC links a member-only document pack and publishers are directed to a CWR representative at ASCAP, BMI or SOCAN.

claims.claim: MusicMark accepts batch registrations via either CWR or EBR (Electronic Batch Registration), a simplified Excel format.
MusicMark is an ASCAP/BMI/SOCAN initiative letting publishers submit and receive via one SFTP site rather than three and receive one common first acknowledgment.
Society codes: 010 ASCAP, 021 BMI, 101 SOCAN, 707 MusicMark.
The test phase is mandatory for all publishers wishing to register CWR files with MusicMark; test files must not exceed 100 works; the 1st Acknowledgment is generated within 24-48 hours.
claims.locator: 2. The Test Phase: An Overview; 6. What to include in your test files

claims.claim: MusicMark asks test files to include works with foreign parties, foreign writers collecting over 100% of the writing share, chain of title, co-publishing, administration and sub-publishing agreements.
claims.locator: 6. What to include in your test files

claims.claim: The file naming convention is CWyynnnnsss_707.Vxx and files that do not follow it are rejected.
Test SFTP is sftp://qaftp.musicmark.com and production is sftp://ftp.musicmark.com, port 22, with different credentials for each.
claims.locator: 4. Accessing the SFTP Site; 11. Going Live

claims.claim: The 1st Acknowledgment header indicates 707MUSICMARK, the file name indicates 707, and work ID numbers are not included.
If a file is rejected, all subsequent files are held until the rejected file is corrected and reposted under the same file name; held files then process in the order received.
ASCAP and BMI generate subsequent 2nd acknowledgments whenever a work record update is made.
ASCAP and BMI assign work IDs when the transaction record includes the territory of the US; SOCAN when it includes Canada; all three when it includes both.
claims.locator: 9. Acknowledgement Information from Societies — Work ID#s

claims.claim: An NP in the MusicMark 1st acknowledgment means the title is not intended for US and/or Canadian registration; an NP in a PRO's 2nd acknowledgment still generates a work ID but means the title is not intended for licensing by that PRO.
claims.locator: 9. Acknowledgement Information from Societies — No Participation

claims.claim: On approval the publisher receives separate production SFTP credentials; the upload, notification and acknowledgment process is otherwise unchanged.
